title: Winter Holidays
subtitle: A Bond That Quietly Grew
quote: Distance doesn't always weaken relationships. Sometimes, it gives two hearts the chance to know each other better.
endQuote: Winter holidays taught me something beautiful. Physical distance couldn't stop two people from becoming closer. Every 'Anna' she sent, every small message, every late reply—I treasured them all. I still didn't know what she would become in my life, but unknowingly, she had already become the most awaited notification on my phone.

content.text: Our conversations had started with studies.
Without either of us realizing it...
Those small conversations became a part of my everyday routine.
The campus that was once filled with laughter suddenly became silent.
Students packed their bags and returned to their hometowns.
For the first time after meeting her, there was a strange emptiness inside me.
Every morning, I would unconsciously open WhatsApp.
Not because I had important messages.
I hoped to see her name appear on my screen.
Sometimes, she would send a message asking about studies.
Sometimes, she would simply ask a small doubt.
But every notification from her made my day a little brighter.
There was one thing that always made me smile.
No matter what we talked about...
Every single message started with the same word.
I used to laugh whenever I saw it.
But every time my phone displayed her name, I smiled before even opening the message.
Sometimes we joked about random things.
Sometimes we simply wished each other a good night.
Talking to Grace had become a part of my daily life.
There were moments when our conversations lasted only a few minutes.
There were other nights when we forgot to notice how quickly time was passing.
The holidays didn't feel boring anymore.
Because no matter where we were...
Our phones had quietly built a bridge between us.
One evening, after finishing our conversation, I placed my phone beside me and smiled.
She looked at me with curiosity.
There was someone whose messages had unknowingly become the happiest part of my day.
I still called her my junior.
A beautiful friendship was slowly taking shape.
Like two strangers who slowly became comfortable talking to each other.
Without knowing what destiny had planned next.
As the winter holidays came to an end, I realized something.
I was actually excited to return to college.
Not because classes were starting again.
Not because I missed the campus.
I would get to see Grace again.
I didn't know what the future held.
I didn't know what our relationship would become.
All I knew was one simple truth.
Every day, I was looking forward to talking to her a little more than the day before.
That's exactly how the most beautiful stories begin.
But with small conversations that slowly become impossible to live without.
